verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly lists a 'Docs' product feature and MCP tools confirm search across tasks, lists, folders, and Docs alongside project data, plus Figma embeds inside Docs show cross-linking with project work. However, evidence is thin—just a one-word feature bullet and indirect MCP references—without detail on doc organization (nesting, permissions, templates, wikis) that a PM would need. Missing for 10: documentation on doc hierarchy/organization structure, sharing/permission controls, and independent hands-on validation of the Docs experience.
